reserveReview.rationale: BHR México's November 25, 2026 reasonable-assurance examination reports MXN 82,960,132.18 (printed rounded total MXN 82,960,132) of CETES reserve assets against MXN 79,465,425.40 of token value in circulation (66,588,691.43 net tokens at MXN 1.193377), a 104.40% reserve ratio. The PDF displays rounded custody balances of MXN 75,463,204 at BBVA, MXN 4,752,982 at BASE, and MXN 2,743,946 at Actinver; those rounded components sum exactly to the displayed rounded total.
